category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, increase masked-item cross-entropy temperature from 0.8 to 1.0 to test whether softer logits improve ranking. This changes only the training objective; masked-target selection, model architecture, inference, optimizer and schedule remain unchanged.

response.change_summary: Change masked-item CE temperature from 0.8 to 1.0 for all four category models. No predictor or checkpoint changes are required.
